propositions: During a single outbound reconcile pass, effective per-project config is resolved redundantly once per ticket rather than once per distinct project, causing repeated filesystem discovery and mapping overlay resolution for the same project

The five `_effective_*_for` helpers and `_effective_link_map_for` each invoke expensive `config.effective_*` or inlined mapping discovery logic on every call within a pass, leading to O(N) work on M distinct projects when M < N

A pass-scoped memoization dict keyed by (axis, project_key) will cache effective maps per project per reconcile invocation, reducing overhead to O(M) while preserving correctness and per-project isolation

The memo cache must be threaded through `compute_outbound_mutations` → mutation builders → `_effective_*_for` helpers as an optional parameter defaulting to None so existing callers and tests remain unchanged

Call-count assertions on `config.effective_status_map` invocations and correctness checks on per-project mutation output will verify the cache is effective (M calls not N) and preserves per-project overlay semantics
